source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.

morphology_documented.habit: Deciduous small tree to ca. 15 m
morphology_documented.leaves: Alternate, simple, up to 20 cm long; usually variable lobing, nearly glabrous except small hair tufts at abaxial vein axils; mostly smooth mature blades (genus key)
morphology_documented.flowers: Unisexual flowers borne on separate catkin-like inflorescences (genus)
morphology_documented.fruit: Mulberry-type multiple fruits usually white or pinkish (genus key), ripe fruits edible
morphology_documented.habitat: Cultivated and naturalized in limestone thickets and disturbed yards

source_scope_note: Genus and key details explicitly noted; where historical flora lacks a species treatment, morphology is limited to independently named secondary sources.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: Historical flora identifies eastern Asian origin; non-native
Fruit color is not independently diagnostic without leaf pubescence and mature structures; purple/black-fruited M. alba also occurs in some populations
preservation: Additive, original taxon records, photos, attribution and site unchanged
